qualification.education_qualification: First class with not less than 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of not less than 6.5 on a 10-point scale in B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering, followed by M.Tech. in Manufacturing, Production, Materials Technology, Welding Technology, Computer-Integrated Manufacturing, Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Systems Engineering Design, Powder Metallurgy, or any other relevant specialization in Mechanical Engineering, with first class and not less than 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of not less than 6.5 on a 10-point scale
qualification.details: Project Assistant: First class with not less than 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of not less than 6.5 on a 10-point scale in B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering, followed by M.Tech. in Manufacturing, Production, Materials Technology, Welding Technology, Computer-Integrated Manufacturing, Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Systems Engineering Design, Powder Metallurgy, or any other relevant specialization in Mechanical Engineering, with first class and not less than 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of not less than 6.5 on a 10-point scale. Candidates with hands-on experience in additive manufacturing, operating powder bed machine/ laser DED machine and experimentation post processing will be preferred.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Warangal Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Warangal Project Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the Project Assistant position at NIT Warangal is 17 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their application is sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Assistant post in the National Institute of Technology Warangal recruitment drive for 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for NIT Warangal Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Assistant position at NIT Warangal is via Email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Assistant position at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a salary of ₹ 20000 + HRA per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Assistant post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First class B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering, followed by an M.Tech. in relevant specializations, both with at least 60% aggregate marks or a CGPA of 6.5.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the NIT Warangal Project Assistant recruitment. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position at NIT Warangal primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Assistant position is Warangal, Telangana, with pincode 506004, as NIT Warangal is situated in this city.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: This Project Assistant position at NIT Warangal is a Contractual job type. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact duration of the contract.
